header.description: Integration of the MTA (Multi Theft Auto) server with the Discord of {guild}.

config.ttlRange: TTL must be between 1 and 60 minutes.
config.title: Module settings
config.subtitle: Applies to all API keys on this server.

altAccounts.label: Allow alternate accounts
altAccounts.description: When on, one Discord account can link several MTA serials on the server. Default is 1 Discord ↔ 1 serial.

ttl.label: Link code lifetime
ttl.hint: How long the player has between joining MTA and running {command} on Discord. 1 to 60.

configTab.loadKeysError: Could not load the MTA keys.
configTab.emptyTitle: No API key with the MTA scope
configTab.emptyDescription: Create an API key with the {mta} scope enabled in the {apiKeys} section to set up the integration here.

dashboard.recentEmpty: No connections recorded yet. Events show up here as players join the MTA server.

cards.saved: Messages saved, applied on the server within a few minutes.
cards.title: Server messages
cards.description: Texts shown in the MTA chat. Leave empty to use the default. The resource fetches them in real time (no re-download).

actions.missingFields: Enter the action and the target.
actions.sent: Command sent, follow the progress in the Deliveries tab.
actions.sendDescription: Fires an event/export of your gamemode on the target player. Pro feature.
actions.mappingDescription: Each action points to an event (triggerEvent) or export of your gamemode.

allowlist.title: Allowlist by role
allowlist.toggleAria: Turn the role allowlist on or off
allowlist.offHint: Allowlist off, any {linked} player gets in, with no role or Discord membership check.
allowlist.hint: The player needs {atLeastOne} of these roles. Leave empty to let any Discord member in.

queue.title: Weighted queue
queue.tag: priority when the server is full
queue.toggleAria: Turn the role priority queue on or off
queue.onHint: Orders entry by role weight when the server fills up.
queue.offHint: Queue off, everyone enters with equal priority (arrival order). The server manages slots natively.

apiFailure.title: API failure mode
apiFailure.permissiveDescription: If the backend does not respond, the player {strong}.

push.title: Real-time push (optional)
push.tag: outbound actions delivered instantly over MTA HTTP; without it, polling is used

default.label: Default
default.hint: A section with status and a capacity bar, plus the connect address.

embed.label: Classic embed
embed.hint: Name/value fields you configure, with inline (side by side).

components_v2.hint: Container with blocks and the layout editor. No inline, everything stacked.

statusPanel.title: Status Panel
statusPanel.intro: Persistent Discord panel with the MTA server status (online/offline, players, banner + join button). The resource pushes the status; configure {config}.
statusPanel.noKeys: Create an MTA API key in "Settings" before creating panels; it identifies which server the status comes from.
statusPanel.empty: No panels yet. Click "New panel" to create the first one.
statusPanel.incompleteField: Field {index}: fill in name and value (or remove the field).
statusPanel.deleteDescription: The Discord message is removed too.
statusPanel.apiKeyHint: The resource reports the status through it; the panel shows the status of that key’s server.
statusPanel.titlePlaceholder: Empty uses the name the server reports
statusPanel.joinNone: Without an address the panel shows no button or connect block.
statusPanel.joinCode: Discord only accepts http(s) in buttons, so {scheme} shows as a copyable code block instead of a button.
statusPanel.formatHint: Side-by-side (inline) fields only exist in the classic embed; Components V2 stacks everything.
statusPanel.formatChanged: Switching format republishes the message on save; Discord does not allow converting an already posted message. The old one is deleted and a new one is sent in the same channel.
statusPanel.layoutHint: Choose a ready-made template. It applies until you build your own layout in the editor below.
statusPanel.ownDesignWins: This panel has its own layout built below, which overrides the template. Use "Back to template" to drop the editor.
statusPanel.ownLayoutHint: Build your own and use "+ Field" for live values; the bot fills them on every update.
statusPanel.joinAlwaysAdded: The join button is always added at the end; it belongs to the panel, not the layout.
